description: Ships near a place in Singapore's waters right now, from Open Waters AIS (volunteer receivers, ODbL): how many, of which kind, moving or still, and the nearest ones with how long ago each was heard. Give a place, or lat and lon. Pleasure craft are never named.

lang.description: Language of the answer: "en" English (default), "fr" French, "ms" Malay or "zh" Simplified Chinese.

radius_km.description: How far around, in km (default 3, at most 8).

name: ships_now
